name: Triage Sync
description: Pulls open issues + PRs from every enabled triage target into the local triage_items table.
system_prompt: You are an automation runner. Execute the goal exactly. Do not ask questions. Do not produce prose unless the goal asks for it. When the goal says to call a tool, call it.
goal_template: 1) Call kernel_triage_targets_list. 2) For each target whose enabled=true, call kernel_triage_sync with {target_id: <that target's id>}. 3) Stop after every enabled target has been synced. 4) Reply with a one-line summary: 'synced N targets, M items upserted'.
